text: Cream standardised to at least 36 % milkfat and heat-treated; US law allows stabilisers, which is why some cartons contain them.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: US heavy cream must hold not less than 36 % milkfat.
The regulation allows heavy cream to be homogenised, but does not require it.
The regulation allows either pasteurisation or ultra-pasteurisation and gives no temperature.
US law allows these optional ingredients, so some cartons contain them.

sources.text: The US regulation for the 36 % minimum, pasteurised or ultra-pasteurised, optional homogenising and optional stabilisers.
